name: Instagram Script Writing
description: Work a day's reel from the Notion calendar to a filed, indexed script. Driven by Luke saying 'let's do October 6' or 'next one'.
agentDescription: Claude Code in the Obsidian vault, following the Instagram Script Writing automation note.
icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 22 22' width='22' height='22' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5'><path d='M5 4h9l3 3v11H5z'/><path d='M8 10h6M8 13h6M8 16h3'/></svg>

skills.name: Pull the day's card
skills.description: Query the month's Reels Content Calendar in Notion by Posting Date; read Idea, pillar, stage, reference and Drive folder

skills.name: Read the script doc
skills.description: Open the one Google Doc in the card's Drive folder: # Transcript and # Script

skills.name: Present and critique
skills.description: Card, both links, source transcript, adapted script, then an honest critique worst problem first

skills.name: Work the draft
skills.description: Change only what Luke asks; raise a concern once, then ship and record it

skills.name: Source client clips
skills.description: Every client quote gets a Fathom deep link with timestamp, or it is dropped

skills.name: File the vault note
skills.description: Content/Instagram/Scripts/<Year>/<Month>/<Upload Date> - <Title>.md from the template

skills.name: Advance the Notion stage
skills.description: One step along Research → Scripting → QA/QC, never past QA/QC automatically

skills.name: Clipboard handoff
skills.description: Rebuild the doc with the approved script and pbcopy it for Cmd+A, Cmd+V

skills.name: Update the month index
skills.description: Row in upload-date order, pillar list, CTA keyword map, blockers and open items

name: Instagram Vault Sync
description: The daily 06:15 launchd job that writes every posted reel and its numbers into the vault. No Claude session needed.
agentDescription: ~/Coding/api-registry/tools/ig_vault_sync.py, run by launchd every day at 06:15.
icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 22 22' width='22' height='22' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5'><path d='M17 8a6 6 0 0 0-11-1'/><path d='M5 14a6 6 0 0 0 11 1'/><path d='M5 3v4h4M17 19v-4h-4'/></svg>

skills.name: Find new reels
skills.description: Instagram API: reels posted in the last 2 days

skills.name: Download and transcribe
skills.description: Download each reel and transcribe it locally on the CPU, about a minute per reel

skills.name: Title the reel
skills.description: One Opus call per new reel for the title, idea, CTA and pillar

skills.name: Refresh analytics
skills.description: Lifetime numbers for the last 30 days, each note dated with measured:

skills.name: Rebuild the indexes
skills.description: Regenerate the auto blocks in the month, year and top-level Script and Analytics indexes

name: Chat Logging
description: Every chat writes itself down as it happens: the hook captures each prompt, Claude keeps the readable note and the chat index current.
agentDescription: The UserPromptSubmit hook plus Claude's half of the Chat Logging automation.
icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 22 22' width='22' height='22' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5'><path d='M3 5h16v10H9l-4 3v-3H3z'/><path d='M7 9h8M7 12h5'/></svg>

skills.name: Capture the prompt
skills.description: chat-log.sh appends the prompt verbatim to Memory/Chats/.raw before Claude sees it

skills.name: Write the chat note
skills.description: First prompt creates Memory/Chats/<date> - <Topic>.md with the session id; later prompts update it in place

skills.name: Update the chat index
skills.description: One line per chat under its theme in 00 Chat Index, loaded every session
